newsitem.title: INDIA: Book profits in August 2nd half, says India I-Sec.
newsitem.headline: Book profits in August 2nd half, says India I-Sec.

text.p: India's ICICI Securities and Finance Company (I-Sec) said it was advising clients to book profits on their debt portfolio in the second half of August.

"The large instalments of advance taxes in mid-September, sorting the oil pool deficit through fiscal adjustments and a possible state loan issue in the month of September is expected to create turbulance in the markets," I-Sec said in its latest debt market update released Monday.
"Hence the second fortnight of August provides a good opportunity to exit positions and book profits," it said.
